connector.name: Buildkite MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MCP server exposing Buildkite API data (pipelines, builds, jobs, tests) to AI tooling and editors.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image buildkite-mcp-server:0.7.0. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the buildkite account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BUILDKITE_API_TOKEN
env.description: Buildkite API token for authentication. Get one from https://buildkite.com/user/api-access-tokens
